assay: four target responses per node (120 total); rank by scratch-minus-source Gaussian log evidence
floor6_top4: after assay, give two more responses to every node (60), then five more to each of top four evidence-ranked nodes (20); total 200
top8_control: after assay, ten more responses to each top-eight node (80); total 200
uniform_control: after assay, distribute 80 responses by quotient/remainder node-index order; total 200
soft_mixture: full-acquired-data Gaussian source-warm/scratch mean mixture with fixed scratch prior mass 0.1
primary_score: independent 1024-context noise-free conditional-mean MSE including held-out term
primary_gate: For both source sizes and both held-out strengths, floor6_top4 soft_mixture changed-node mean MSE <=0.8x uniform soft_mixture and <=1.05x floor6_top4 scratch; unchanged-node mean MSE <=1.05x uniform soft_mixture and <=1.05x floor6_top4 source_warm. Report top-four nomination and paired intervals. Top-eight is contextual, not a rescue comparator.
custody: 40 source cells and 80 target setting cells; count 48000 source responses and 48000 target arm-response counts. Hash source observations, posteriors, acquired target responses, action allocation, evaluation design, conditional truth, metrics; report within-cell and global unique acquired prefixes and deterministic replay.
forbidden: No changed label, latent coefficient, evaluator design or private outcome enters allocation or fitting. No closed-source model API. Do not tune floor, top-four size, strength, seeds or gate after outcomes.
